record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the 0.8*h_t+0.2*m_t causal readout but make pooling half-life depend on observed prefix length n_t: 3+min(max(n_t-16,0)/32,1). Short histories retain the incumbent half-life of three; longer histories gradually use four to retain broader interests. Count only real causal inputs, exclude padding and future states, and use the final real position at inference. Synchronize predictor metadata and writer; preserve truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer.
